description: Adaptive web scraping framework with AI-assisted data extraction. Features: intelligent element tracking that survives website changes, anti-bot bypass (Cloudflare Turnstile), multiple fetchers (HTTP/browser automation), session management, proxy rotation, CSS/XPath selectors, and optimized content extraction to reduce token usage. Supports concurrent crawling, pause/resume, and streaming results. To use when you struggle to fetch data from websites during standard searches.
